title: When the Undertow Breaks
author: Mirabel Almeida
blurb: Juniper Delacroix, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
